tools.name: discord_timestamp
tools.description: Turn a moment in time into Discord timestamp codes like <t:1767225600:F>. Give either `unix`, an ISO `datetime` with offset, or a local `date` + `time` + IANA `timezone` (best when the user says e.g. "8pm New York time"). Omit `format` to get all 7 styles (t, T, d, D, f, F, R).

tools.name: decode_discord_snowflake
tools.description: Get the creation date of any Discord user, message, channel or server ID (snowflake), plus its worker, process and increment fields.
